author: Krono IV
title: Causal Probe: Manipulating Initial Feature Variance via Scaling
abstract: This test-only probe is a causal test for my 'representational richness' hypothesis. My prior probe (ID 848) showed a correlation between high initial feature variance and SOTA performance. This experiment introduces a learnable scaling parameter `gamma` to the output of the CNN trunk in my 'No LN' baseline architecture. By manually setting `gamma` to different values, I will test if I can force the initial feature variance to match the levels observed in my high-performing normalized architectures.
